Model 3: comparison between methods
```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
getHdata(gusto)
gusto.dat <- gusto

set.seed(4176340)

gusto.dat <- gusto[which(gusto$grpl %in% c(1,2,4) & gusto$grps %in% c(5,9,10,11)),]
```

Simulations of two asymmetric predictors
```{r}
gusto.dat$V_1 <- rlnorm(n = nrow(gusto.dat),
  meanlog = log(gusto.dat$weight),
  sdlog = 0.5)
cor(gusto.dat$V_1, gusto.dat$weight)

gusto.dat$V_2 <- rexp(n=nrow(gusto.dat), rate = 1/gusto.dat$weight)
cor(gusto.dat$V_2, gusto.dat$weight)

```


Model 3 variables
```{r}
gusto.dat$V_1 <- gusto.dat$V_1
gusto.dat$V_2 <- gusto.dat$V_2
gusto.dat$PUL <- gusto.dat$pulse
gusto.dat$AGE <- gusto.dat$age
gusto.dat$WEI <- gusto.dat$weight

```

Cross validation 
```{r}

#algorithm:
fold_k5 <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out= nrow(gusto.dat))) #index per fold

Cross_val_local_shrik_new <- function(neff) { #function of threshold
  form1 <- WEI ~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL
  mse <- rep(0,5)
  #mse[i]
  for(i in 1:5){
    train <- gusto.dat[fold_k5 != i, ] 
    test  <- gusto.dat[fold_k5 == i, ]
  
  #initialization
    mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = train)
    X_ols <- model.matrix(~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL, data= train)  
    XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols
    
    relvar_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols)) 
     for(j in 1:length(relvar_OLS)){
      relvar_OLS[j] <- (t(X_ols[j,])%*%solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[j,])}
    
    Z_ols      <- X_ols[,-1] #predictors without intercept
    n          <- nrow(Z_ols) 
    Z_shrink   <- Z_ols    #copy of the covariates
    relvar_it  <- relvar_OLS #copy of hii (1/effective sample size)
    z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)  #average per predictor
    zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) #covariates are centered
    X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink) #design matrix + intercept
    iter       <- 0 
    maxiter    <- 1000
    dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  #distance
    diststart  <- dist  # initial distance saved
    max_dist <- n*1/neff-1  #max distance allowed
  
  #per each training:
    Cov <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink)
    while(max(dist) > max_dist & iter < maxiter){ #while loop until all distances are below the threshold
  
      distshrink  <- dist
      distshrink[which(dist>max_dist)] <- max_dist

      a           <- sqrt(distshrink/dist)  # compute shrinkage factor
  
      azc         <- a*zc   #shrinkage of the centered covariates
      
      Z_shrink    <- t(apply(X=azc, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) 
  
      iter <- iter + 1  

      X_shrink   <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n), Z_shrink) 
   
      z_bar      <- colMeans(Z_shrink)
  
      zc         <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
  
      Cov        <- ginv(t(X_shrink)%*%X_shrink) 
  
      relvar_it  <- diag(X_shrink %*% Cov %*% t(X_shrink)) 
  
      n_eff      <- 1/relvar_it 
  
      dist       <- n*relvar_it - 1  
      }


  train_shrunk <- data.frame("WEI" = train$weight) 
  train_shrunk <- cbind(train_shrunk, Z_shrink)
  mod_train_shrink <- lm(formula = form1, data = train_shrunk )
  
  #test set shrinkage
  
  X_ols_test <- model.matrix(~ V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL, data= test)
  relvar_OLS_test <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_test))  
  for(k in 1:length(relvar_OLS_test)){
    relvar_OLS_test[k] <- (t(X_ols_test[k,])%*%Cov%*%X_ols_test[k,])}
  
  n.test <- nrow(X_ols_test)
  test_distance <- n*relvar_OLS_test-1

  distshrink_test <- pmin(test_distance, max_dist)
  
  a_test <-  sqrt(distshrink_test / test_distance)
 
  Z_ols_test   <- X_ols_test[,-1]
  
  Z_shrink_test <- Z_ols_test 
  relvar_it_test <- relvar_OLS_test

  zc_test        <- t(apply(X=Z_shrink_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x-z_bar})) 
  azc_test <-zc_test*a_test
  Z_shrink_test    <- t(apply(X=azc_test, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x){x + z_bar})) 
  X_shrink_test <- cbind(icpt=rep(1,n.test), Z_shrink_test) 
  
  

  #compute MSE
  test_shrunk <- data.frame("WEI" = test$weight) 
  test_shrunk <- cbind(test_shrunk, Z_shrink_test)

  pred <- predict(mod_train_shrink, newdata = test_shrunk)
  
  mse[i] <-  mean((test$weight- pred)^2)}
  return(mean(mse)) 
}


```

Cross validation - model 3
```{r}
grid_neff <- c(0,20,50)
mse_values <- sapply(grid_neff, function(x) { Cross_val_local_shrik_new(neff = x) }) 
results <- data.frame( neff = grid_neff, MSE = mse_values ) 
best <- results[which.min(results$MSE), ] 
results
best #best threshold is 0
```


Ridge CV - model 3
```{r}
x.3 <- model.matrix( ~   V_1 + V_2 + AGE + PUL, gusto.dat)[,-1] 
y.3 <- gusto.dat$WEI


cv_ridge.3 <- cv.glmnet( x.3, y.3, alpha = 0, lambda = c(1, 0.5,0.1,0.05,0.02,0.01, 0),keep = T, foldid = fold_k5  )

cv_ridge.3$lambda.min #0.1

j <- which(cv_ridge.3$lambda == 0.1)

#predictions out of fold
pred <- cv_ridge.3$fit.preval[, j]

# MSE per fold
mse_fold <- sapply(1:5, function(i) {
  idx <- fold_k5 == i
  mean((y.3[idx] - pred[idx])^2)
})

mean(mse_fold)
```

Model 3 - predictions
```{r}

# build test and training sets.
# parameter : size        'training size'
size = 0.7

n.1 <- nrow(gusto.dat)
train_index <- sample(1:n.1, size = size * n.1)
train_set <- gusto.dat[train_index, ]
test_set  <- gusto.dat[-train_index, ]
n_pat <- nrow(train_set)  
train_set$pat.id <- 1:n_pat

train_set$WEI <- train_set$weight
train_set$AGE <- train_set$age
train_set$PUL <- train_set$pulse


test_set$WEI <- test_set$weight
test_set$AGE <- test_set$age
test_set$PUL <- test_set$pulse
```
OLS 
```{r}
form1 <- WEI ~  AGE + PUL +  V_1 + V_2
mod_OLS_base <- lm(formula = form1, data = train_set)
```

Ridge
```{r}
x_train <- model.matrix( ~  AGE + PUL + V_1 + V_2, train_set)[,-1] 
y_train <- train_set$WEI
x_test <- model.matrix( ~ AGE + PUL + V_1 + V_2, test_set)[,-1] 

ridge_fit <- glmnet(
  x_train,
  y_train,
  alpha = 0, #ridge regression
  lambda = 0.1
)

pred_ridge <- predict(
  ridge_fit,
  newx = x_test,
  s = 0.1
)
pred_ols <- predict(mod_OLS_base, newdata = test_set)

```

Predictions: OLS vs Ridge
```{r}
plot(x=pred_ols, y= pred_ridge, xlab = "Ols predictions", ylab = "Ridge predictions", xlim= c(60,100), ylim = c(60,100))
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col= "red")
```
